_readme: SPIM 4D pipeline config. Most users only need to edit input.directory, output.directory, and toggle the *_enabled flags. Paths can be absolute or relative to the repo dir. Input accepts a folder of per-timepoint TIFFs (t0001_*.tif, t0002_*.tif, ...) or a single hyperstack file (.czi, .tif, .tiff).

input._comment_directory: Folder = per-timepoint TIFFs named t0001_*.tif, ... File = single hyperstack (.czi, .tif, .tiff).
input._comment_channel: 1-based channel index. Ignored for folder inputs (channel is in the filename).
input._comment_max_timepoints: Process only the first N timepoints (after any timepoints filter below). null = use all matching timepoints.
input._comment_timepoints: Process ONLY these specific timepoints. Each entry can be a numeric timepoint index (1-based: 1, 5, 10) or a filename stem ('t0001', 't0005'). null = use all timepoints (subject to max_timepoints). When set, max_timepoints is applied AFTER this filter.

output._comment_directory: Where to write results. Will be created if it does not exist.
output._comment_correct_y: Flip Y axis to fix microscope orientation.
output._comment_skip_merge: Skip the final 4D merge. Recommended for large data; you only need per-timepoint TIFFs for the viewer.

seqera_tower._comment: Paste your Seqera Platform access token to monitor runs in the browser (https://tower.nf -> Runs). Get one from tower.nf -> Settings -> Your tokens.

roi_cropping._comment: Crop every timepoint to a region drawn in Fiji (Edit > Selection > Add to Manager > save as .roi). Leave enabled=false to skip.

voxel_size._comment: Physical voxel size in micrometres. Required for tracking. auto_detect=true tries to read it from file metadata (CZI / OME-TIFF).

preprocessing._comment: Modular preprocessing pipeline. Each stage has its own 'enabled' toggle and its own params. Stages run in the order listed below. Infrastructure stages (load, downscale_xy, final_cast) are always on; the actual processing steps are toggleable.
preprocessing._comment_method: 'deconvolution' (GPU Richardson-Lucy, uses deconvolution_3d.psf_path) or 'selfnet' (deep-learning deblurring, uses selfnet.model_path).

voxel_size._comment: Voxel size (µm). For standalone use only — the Nextflow wrapper overwrites this from the per-timepoint metadata. To auto-detect from file metadata, leave auto_detect=true.

downscale_xy._comment: XY downscale (skimage.rescale). 1.0 = no downscale. 0.33 trades resolution for speed/RAM. Always on; 'factor' is the only knob.

shading_correction._comment: XY illumination flat-field correction (gaussian-blurred mean projection).

z_intensity_correction._comment: Multiplicative per-slice Z intensity correction (compensates depth attenuation / bleaching).

isotropic_reslice._comment: Resample Z so voxels become isotropic (match XY pixel size). Required for downstream 3D ops.

deconvolution_3d._comment: GPU Richardson-Lucy on PSF. Skipped silently if niter <= 0 even when enabled=true.

deconvolution_xz._comment: GPU Richardson-Lucy on transposed XZ view. Skipped silently if niter <= 0 even when enabled=true.

background_subtraction._comment: Wavelet-based background subtraction (WBNS) on XY then on transposed XZ stack. Set enabled=false to skip.

gaussian_smooth._comment: Final Gaussian smoothing on the preprocessed volume.

clahe._comment: Slice-wise adaptive histogram equalisation (CLAHE) on the transposed XZ stack.

percentile_normalization._comment: Percentile-based outlier removal before final cast. Set p_low=0 and p_high=100 to effectively disable without changing the enabled flag.

final_cast._comment: Final rescale to [min_v, max_v] and cast to dtype.

selfnet._comment: Only used when method = 'selfnet'. Neural-net deblurring replaces deconvolution_3d + deconvolution_xz.
selfnet._comment_per_view: Optional per-view models. Leave null to reuse model_path for both XZ and YZ.
selfnet._comment_net_normalization: Training-matched percentile normalisation applied to the Self-Net input. Set no_net_normalization=true to feed the corrected stack directly.

preprocessing._comment_image_scaling_alias: Deprecated. Downscale factor is now downscale_xy.factor. This top-level alias is read by older code (e.g. merge_hyperstack.py) — keep it in sync with downscale_xy.factor or leave it out and the Python driver will populate it from downscale_xy.factor at runtime.

simulation._comment: Used only by --simulate mode. Each experiment runs preprocessing + Cellpose on the preprocessed image and counts nuclei as an objective quality metric. The Cellpose params (model, diameter, thresholds, etc.) are read from the top-level `segmentation` block so the simulation always uses the same Cellpose config as the real segmentation. To override per-sweep, set `cellpose` in the sweep JSON.

debug_preprocessing._comment: Optional per-timepoint QA. Saves side-by-side raw vs preprocessed for the first timepoints.

segmentation._comment: 3D Cellpose segmentation. Runs on a GPU node. Set enabled=false to skip.
segmentation._comment_model: Path to a Cellpose model folder or a built-in name ('cyto3', 'nuclei', ...).
segmentation._comment_anisotropy: Z/Y voxel ratio. null = auto-derived from voxel_size.
segmentation._comment_stitch_threshold: Stitching threshold for multi-FOV tiles. null = no stitching.
segmentation._comment_downscale_labels: Downscale the saved label volume by this factor. 1.0 = full res. Useful when the label volume is too big for the viewer.

benchmark._comment: Writes a small CSV/JSON with per-timepoint timing and memory stats.

tracking._comment: Cell tracking with ultrack. Set enabled=true to run the full chain (prep -> segment -> link -> solve -> export). Needs segmentation enabled too.

prep._comment: Foreground / contour extraction parameters used before linking.

simulation._comment: Optional. When enabled=true with a sweep_file, Nextflow fans out one SLURM job per (experiment × timepoint) instead of running the main pipeline. CLI fallback still works: python3 spim_pipeline_fixed.py --simulate --sweep_file X.json.

system._comment: Container images and resume behaviour. Most users never need to touch this.
system._comment_resume: true = reuse finished tasks on re-submission. false = force a clean re-run.
